page.overview:
Who is Arazlam Jenomis Durai?

Arazlam Jenomis Durai is a minor character from Final Fantasy Tactics. While the character is referred to as Alazlam J. D. and Alazlam J. Durai in the original Final Fantasy Tactics (his identity as a descendant of Orran Durai not being revealed until the end of the game), the War of the Lions port shortens his name to Arazlam Durai. In The Ivalice Chronicles, his introduction is named Arazlam J.D. and his full name is revealed at the end of the game.

Arazlam is the descendant of Orran Durai, the writer of the Durai Papers, which were never published since Orran was executed for heresy. Arazlam claims to have rediscovered the report, curiously not destroyed by the Church of Glabados, and convinces the player that the so-called hero Delita Heiral was not what he seemed to be, and that the relatively unknown Ramza Beoulve was the real hero.

Arazlam is 53 years old. In the CGI cel-shaded scenes, he gets the map of Ivalice and reads the Durai Papers before the scene changes to 400 years ago where Delita along with his group are heading to Orbonne. It seems that the events of Final Fantasy Tactics take place 400 and some years before Arazlam Durai finds the papers, as hinted by one of the books he wrote, The Durai Papers: 400 Years of Truth.

In The Ivalice Chronicles, Arazlam's faction is indicated as being the National Akademy of Valendia.
